exercise.source: Group Cycle Connect and Samsung Health / Galaxy Watch3 screenshots
exercise.notes: Steady, solid RPM session. Bike 43:06, 21 km, 607 kcal, 1099 MOVEs, 210 W avg, 410 W max, 77 rpm cadence. Watch 43:11, 468 kcal, HR 151 avg/174 max; some missing HR data shown. Calorie estimates are alternative device readings, not additive.

post_workout_feedback.effort: Strong steady solid effort, not deliberately maximal
post_workout_feedback.resistance_strategy: Increased resistance at both the high end of hard efforts and the low end of recovery; does not back off as much as previously
post_workout_feedback.user_feedback: I didn't try to push really hard this one, just tried to keep pretty steady solid, a really good solid effort. I did up the top end resistance and for recovery I don't back off as far as I used to; increased resistance at bottom and top end of efforts.
post_workout_feedback.session_intention: Planned a solid, controlled workout rather than pushing extremely hard
post_workout_feedback.notable_interval: Track six included approximately three-minute sprint, unexpectedly very hard and substantially outside comfort zone
post_workout_feedback.overall_perceived_effort: Solid controlled effort for most of session, with one exceptionally hard sprint
post_workout_feedback.user_follow_up: It was really solid. Had a substantial effort in the sixth track, like a three-minute sprint, and that was really, really hard. I wasn't expecting that; mindset was to do a nice solid session but not push too hard. It pushed me into a really uncomfortable position.
